reason: Computed by the fail-first replay against base 5ef8be11fdc2, and judged not a defect on the block's own rule ('a behavior-preserving refactor's tests pass by design'). The tests that pass at base are coverage backfills for corruption classes the implementation already handled there: F4 was explicitly a TEST gap, not an implementation gap, and the F5/F6 restructures are behaviour-preserving. The behaviour this diff changed IS pinned - 22 of 38 touched tests fail at base, including every invalid-UTF-8 and non-object-payload case. The lead test named, test_each_corruption_class_is_named_in_its_own_words_on_stderr, exists to defeat a self-oracling suite and was proven to bind by installing a deliberately weakened load() over docket.py: 6 of its 7 cases failed, after which the file was restored from git.
